verdict.rationale: Thoropass shows it provides the audit itself in-house: a HITRUST Accredited Assessor (docs-69), third-party assessment and attestation bundled with readiness (docs-70, docs-68), a "reliable audit partner" for PCI (docs-51), and audits run "from scoping through final report" in one platform (docs-66, docs-25). However, nothing documents how a founder actually books or schedules the audit, and there are no published timeline expectations beyond a vague claim of "accelerating audit cycle times" (docs-43). Missing for 10: documented audit booking/scheduling flow, published audit timeline expectations, independent corroboration of the in-house audit arm.
